name: execute_webmcp_tool
description: Executes a WebMCP tool exposed by the page.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

toolName.description: The name of the WebMCP tool to execute

input.description: The JSON-stringified parameters to pass to the WebMCP tool

name: list_webmcp_tools
description: Lists all WebMCP tools the page exposes.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

name: new_page
description: Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated (useful for clean-slate testing of cookies and authentication).

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.
